In this vignette, we recreate all the gene expression plots from the paper. 

```{r}

rm(list=ls())

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(RColorBrewer)

s1 = 1# size for points in PCA plot
legend_pt_size =4
plot_title_size = 25
axis_text_size = 20
axis_title_size=20
legend_text_size=25
spacing=1
chosen_margin = c(0.5,1,0.5,1)# margins:top,right,bottom,left
theme_clean <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0, vjust=0, 
                                  lineheight=.8, face="bold", size=plot_title_size ),
        plot.margin=unit(chosen_margin,"cm"), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=legend_text_size),
        legend.key.height = unit(spacing, "cm"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.justification = 'left',
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, 'cm'),
        legend.title=element_blank() , 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank())


gene_exp_file = readRDS("log2tpm.rds")
umap_data2 = read.delim("final_metadata_3_12_2026.txt" , header=T, stringsAsFactors=F)
score = readRDS("pathways.rds")

myPalette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu"))) # for gene expression

my_gene_fun = function(goi){
    goi = intersect(goi, rownames(gene_exp_file))    
    l1 = lapply(goi, function(my_goi){
        message(my_goi)
        mat= umap_data2
        mat$gene_exp = unlist(gene_exp_file[ match(my_goi, rownames(gene_exp_file)), ])              
        mat = mat[ order(mat$gene_exp, decreasing=FALSE), ]
        ylim = max(mat$gene_exp)
        ylow = min(mat$gene_exp )
        sc <- scale_colour_gradientn(colours = myPalette(ylim), limits=c(ylow, ylim))        
        fig1 =  ggplot(mat, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=gene_exp )) +
            geom_point(size=2) + ggtitle(paste0( my_goi)) + 
            sc + theme_clean +  
            theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.72, 0.3) )
        
        fig1
    })
}

my_gene_VIOLIN_fun = function(goi){
    goi = intersect(goi, rownames(gene_exp_file))    
    l1 = lapply(goi, function(my_goi){
        message(my_goi)
        mat= umap_data2
        mat$gene_exp = unlist(gene_exp_file[ match(my_goi, rownames(gene_exp_file)), ])              
        mat = mat[ order(mat$gene_exp, decreasing=FALSE), ]
              
        fig1 =  ggplot(mat, aes(x = cohorts,  y=gene_exp, fill = cohorts )) +
            geom_boxplot() + ggtitle(paste0( my_goi)) + 
             ylab("log2(TPM+1)") + xlab("") +
            theme_bw() +
            theme(
                plot.title = element_text(hjust=0, vjust=0, 
                                          lineheight=.8, face="bold", size=plot_title_size ),
                plot.margin=unit(chosen_margin,"cm"), 
                legend.text=element_text(size=legend_text_size),
                legend.key.height = unit(spacing, "cm"),
                legend.position = "none",
                legend.justification = 'left',
                legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, 'cm'),
                legend.title=element_blank() , 
                axis.title.x=element_text(size=axis_title_size),
                axis.text.x=element_text(size=20, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
                axis.title.y=element_text(size=axis_title_size),
                axis.text.y=element_text(size=20) )               
        
        fig1
    })
}


# fig2 :

a1 = my_gene_fun(c("NKX2-1", "KRT5", "NEUROD1"  ))
pdf(file.path( "Figures/Multiplot_validation.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist =  lst, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()

                   "CYP24A1", "GCLC", "SLC7A11",  # A4
                   "CDK1", "E2F1","PLK1" ))
pdf(file.path( "Figures/Multiplot_NEW_FIG3.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = a1, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()

a11 = my_gene_VIOLIN_fun(c("ASCL1","INSM1",  "MYCN","MYCL",  "SYP", "NCAM", "CHGB", "INSM1", "DLL3", "RET", 
                           "FASN", "NQO1", # A2 
                           "CYP24A1", "GCLC", "SLC7A11",  # A4
                           "CDK1", "E2F1","PLK1" 
))
pdf(file.path( "Figures/Multiplot_NE_GENES_VIOLIN.pdf"), height = 20, width = 15)
ggarrange( plotlist =c( NA,  a11), nrow =6, ncol =3)
dev.off()
              
# fig 4 
a1 = my_gene_fun(c("CD8A", "PDCD1","CTLA4",  "HAVCR2", "CD86", "CD274" ))
pdf(file.path( "Figures/Multiplot_IMMUNE_GENES.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = c(a1,k1), nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()


# supp fig 4

pdf(file.path( "Figures/Multiplot_TUMOR_PURITY_IMMUNE_GENES.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = a1, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()

# fig 7 
a1 = my_gene_fun(c("KIT", "RET","DLL3",   "NTRK2",   "MET", "ROS1" ))
pdf(file.path( "Figures/Multiplot_TARGETS.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = lst, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()

a1 = my_gene_VIOLIN_fun(c("KIT", "RET","DLL3",   "NTRK2",   "MET", "ROS1" ))
pdf(file.path( "Figures/Multiplot_TARGETS_violinplot.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = lst, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()


```
